title: Wise Men Still Seek Him
series: Light in the Darkness: Advent and Epiphany
description: Who is this, and what does it cost to follow him?
This week we open Matthew 2:1–12 and ask what the passage is really saying, before we ask what it means for us.
We notice how the passage fits into the larger story of Light in the Darkness, and what has come just before it.
Along the way we meet some familiar excuses, and some better reasons to hope.
We finish with a few simple questions to take home and talk over with a friend this week.
